messages.message: '// eslint-disable-next-line require-yield, sonarjs/generator-without-yield -- the interface requires a generator; PGlite has no cursor API here' has no effect because you have 'noInlineConfig' setting in your config.

'// eslint-disable-next-line sonarjs/no-os-command-from-path -- Operator-installed psql intentionally resolves through the trusted host PATH; connection input supplies PG fields, never the executable or PATH.' has no effect because you have 'noInlineConfig' setting in your config.
